name: Structured extraction
description: 10 texts where the model returns the requested fields as a JSON object, scored per field.
prompt_template:
Extract the requested fields from the text. Reply with only a JSON object using exactly the field names given.

{input}

items.input:
Fields: name (string), age (number), city (string)
Text: Meera Iyer, 29, moved to Pune last year to join a design studio.

Fields: product (string), price (number), currency (string)
Text: The new SoundMax headphones are now available for 2,499 INR on our website.

Fields: date (YYYY-MM-DD), team_home (string), team_away (string), score_home (number), score_away (number)
Text: On 14 March 2025, Chennai Kings beat Delhi Riders 3-1 at home.

Fields: title (string), author (string), year (number)
Text: "The Silent River" was written by Arjun Mehta and published in 2019.

Fields: email (string), phone (string), company (string)
Text: Contact our sales lead at sales@brightlabs.io or call +1-415-555-0199. Bright Labs replies within a day.

Fields: flight (string), origin (string), destination (string), gate (string)
Text: Flight AI 202 from Hyderabad to Singapore will now board at gate 14B.

Fields: ingredients (list of strings), servings (number)
Text: This pancake recipe serves 4 and needs flour, milk, eggs and sugar.

Fields: company (string), amount (number, in millions of dollars), round (string)
Text: Startup NovaGrid raised $45 million in a Series B round led by Horizon Ventures.

Fields: temperature_c (number), condition (string), city (string)
Text: Expect sunny skies in Jaipur today with a high of 38 degrees Celsius.

Fields: order_id (string), items (number), status (string)
Text: Your order #A7781 with 3 items has been shipped and will arrive Thursday.
